page.layout: One page of running text in one column. Marginal notes in the right margin, some in Greek. Running head at top left, page number at top right.

main_text.p: {a}Homero edocti[?] sunt, Vlysse, multa medacia dixis-Odyss. li.19.ἴσκα [?] ... πολλὰ λέγωνse veris similia: aut illud ex Iuvenal. Satyr.14.{b}Satyrico poeta didi-cerunt, Fallit enim vitium specie virtutis & umbra.ἐτύμοισιν ὁμοῖα[?] Nam ex his intelligunt improbè deludi se à Iesui-ta,qui,quoniam idolo & mendacio veritas, ut vi-tio virtus, opponitur, propterea negat idolum rei verae speciem & similitudinem referre. Quòd si oculos claudere contra tam perspicuam lucem perrexerint, & obfirmârint cor suum more {c}Iudæo-Efai.6.10.rum,ne cernant oculis, corde intelligant, conver-Matt.13.15. Act.28.27.tantúrque & sanentur: sciant se illos esse,quos Plato, citante Bellarmino, ait pluris facere mendacia & idola quàm veritatem. Et quid aliud sperent quàm præmium eorum,{d}qui dilexerunt potiusIoh.3.19. tenebras quàm lucem:ut cum meretrice,cuius{e}au-Apoc.17.4.reo poculo inebriantur,pereant? {f}Vecors adolef-Prov.7.ver.7.&22.cens, pellectus lenociniis adulterae, sequitur eam, tanquam bos ad mactationem abiit, & velut compeditus ad eruditionem stultorum, donec diffecet culter iecur ipsius, quemadmodum festinat avis ad laqueum, nesciens contra vitam suam illum esse.

page.notes: Greek marginal notes are uncertain: the first line (ἴσκα) and the phrase after it are only partly legible, and the ἐτύμοισιν ὁμοῖα line is a best reading. The word "edocti" and the word "diffecet" are doubtful. "Vecors" is printed with a capital V. The reference mark a is a decorative symbol in the text, so its position is approximate. Page is otherwise clear.
